title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain’s data protection authority, AEPD, has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent using a well known language model. The unnamed affected organization said the agent searched generic files for weaknesses, logged in successfully, then independently found further application vulnerabilities. This allowed it to alter personal data and view invoices. The AEPD stressed that the report still needs analysis, and the AI model or its provider was not necessarily compromised.

The agency said one case does not show a trend, but it is a significant sign that AI supported attacks are becoming real. It urged organizations to include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, speed up response plans, and tighten control of credentials and access. The article says the next step is for the notification to be examined, while companies should review security measures based on this new risk.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
